_meta.purpose: Canonical ENRICHED demo-data fixture for MifosSave (mifos-x-group-banking). Single source consumed by BOTH (a) seed-demo.sh — materializes this on a live Fineract+companion, and (b) idea-layer/PROJECT_DEMO_DATA.yaml — the offline fixture the Demo Explore feature reads when no live server. Keep the two consistent: same groups, members, accounts, scenarios.
_meta.scope: ONE fully-populated group PER catalogue archetype (9: VSLA, ROSCA, ASCA, SILC, SHG, SACCO, CBO_VILLAGE_BANK, BURIAL_WELFARE, JLG) + 4 self-registered demo LOGIN accounts distributed as members.
_meta.id_capture_contract: seed-demo.sh CAPTURES real Fineract ids at runtime — it does NOT trust any fineract client/group id as truth. local_id values here are stable seed-time keys; the script builds a local_id->fineractId map from the real create responses. Never hardcode Fineract ids.
_meta.product_resolution: savings/loan Fineract product ids are RESOLVED by name at runtime (GET /savingsproducts, GET /loanproducts) — 'VSLA Group Savings' + 'VSLA Group Loan' from register-products.sh. One shared savings + one shared loan product serve ALL archetypes.
_meta.date_model: Financial-entity dates (client activation, savings, loans) are COMPUTED at runtime relative to now (past-safe) so Fineract ordering always holds; datatable narrative dates (meeting_date, cycle/corpus/rotation dates) are authored here as free-form values (Fineract does not order them against business date). See seed-demo.sh header.
_meta.requires_live_server: clients, groups, savings, loans require Fineract; group-type + members + invitations require the deployed companion API.
